status: specified before secondary outcome inspection; not a public preregistration

datasets.busbra: unchanged private frozen CSV; supplied five patient-disjoint folds
datasets.wdbc: scikit-learn 1.6.1 bundled UCI WDBC, 569 cases and 30 cytology features; not an external ultrasound validation cohort

wdbc_outer_cv: StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42); one case per row, no independently verified repeated-patient mapping
svm_grid: identical 32 candidate choices to the primary protocol
author_gbfrs: optional unchanged private author script, fixed purity 0.9, NumPy seed 42; never redistributed; report failure rather than silently patching it
selection: joint inner mean macro-F1; ties mean accuracy, fewer features, configuration order, SVM grid order
search_budget_note: Rank and L1 baselines have three selector settings crossed with 32 SVM settings, versus 32 for fixed selectors. This is not a matched-compute-budget comparison.
zero_feature_rule: a selector setting producing zero features in an inner training fold is ineligible; do not invent a fallback feature
